To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reliability of the cold standby systems is a complex process that depends not only on the reliability of the components of the system but also on the time to repair of the failed component and the time to failure in the cold standby.
(1) The reliability function of the cold standby with renewal can be represented by the semi Markov process.

the semi Markov reliability theory can be applied to the analysis of cold standby systems and that the semi MarkOV reliability model can be used as an approximate model to calculate the reliability functions of the cold standby systems.
